components.note: ⺈ (bent person) — a person's figure, the top part of 色. Old story: a person (⺈) sitting on 巴 shows how feelings colour the face, hence 'colour, look'; treat as a memory aid.
巴 (bā) — the lower part; dictionary reads the pair as 'what a person desires'. Memory aid: a face reddening with feeling is a 'colour'.
厶 (bent arm/private) — the top part. How it joins 儿 to mean 'permit' is unclear. Memory aid: a person (儿) with a hand raised to say yes.
儿 (legs/person) — the bottom part and radical, as in 兄 and 先. It shows a person, but does not explain 允 on its own.
艹 (grass) — the plant radical, as in 花 flower and 草 grass; it points to crops and harvest, the sense in 收获. Simplified 获 replaces 獲's left side with 艹.
犾 (dog-like part) — a variant of 犬 dog; 獲 originally meant catching game. Memory aid: grass plus a hunting dog, you bring something home.
凵 (open box) — the bottom part and dictionary radical. 击 simplifies 擊, whose 手 (hand) hinted at striking. Memory aid: a blow landing in a hollow.
尺 (chǐ, ruler) — the visible top part, as in 尺寸 size. 尽 simplifies 盡 and the shape does not explain 'use up'. Memory aid: measure it to the very end.
舟 (boat) — the left part and radical, as in 船 ship. Meaning hint: boats, a tray.
殳 (weapon/tool in hand) — the right part, also in 段 and 投 (throw). Story: handling a tool on a tray to sort things into kinds, hence 'sort, kind'; memory aid only.
又 (hand) — the bottom-right part and radical, a hand. Dictionary story: the 'smaller (小) brother' of the family; used for a father's younger brother, as in 叔叔.
上 (up) — the top left part, combined with 小 (small) to form the left side of 叔. Memory aid: the small one coming up behind Dad is 'uncle'.
龶 (plant-like top) — dictionary reads the top as 'a poisonous plant'. Memory aid: a plant growing on top of a mother (母) is something you must not eat.
母 (mǔ, mother) — the bottom part and radical. Sound clue is lost today (毒 is dú); use it as a visual memory aid, as in 母亲.
火 (fire) — the bottom part, as in 灯 lamp and 炎 flame. The dictionary lists fire as the hint: a spirit like a flickering flame, as in 灵魂.
彐 (snout) — the top part, a stroke group as in 当 and 归. 灵 simplifies 靈, so this shape is not a sound clue. Memory aid: a hand over a flame, feeling a spirit.
木 (tree) — the bottom part, as in 林 forest and 树 tree; in old 雜 the tree or clothing bits show collecting many things. Treat as a loose hint only.
九 (nine) — the top part; 杂 is simplified from 雜. Memory aid: nine kinds of wood piled up, a mix.
禾 (grain) — the top part, as in 和 and 秋. Memory aid: a woman (女) bending under a bundle of grain; grain plus woman gives 'bend / entrust', now 'appoint'.
女 (woman) — the bottom part and radical, as in 她 she and 妈 mom. Here it hints at a yielding, bending figure rather than a woman.
亠 (lid) — the top part, a cap. Memory aid: a lid on top of 允 suggests something filled up to the lid, hence 'fill, be full' as in 充满.
允 (yǔn, permit) — the bottom part; it is a visible piece, but not a sound clue today (充 is chōng). Memory aid: allowed to fill up.
广 (house) — the top-left cover, as in 店 shop and 床 bed; it marks a building or room.
隶 (servant) — inside 广. Dictionary story: a home with a servant, healthy and untroubled, hence 健康 health; origin is uncertain, so memory aid only.
丬 (bed/couch, left side) — the left strip, a bed seen sideways. Dictionary story: going to bed at night, the 'future' that is sure to come; read as a memory aid.
夕 (evening) — upper part of the right side, as in 外 and 多; with 寸 (hand/inch) it frames 将 meaning 'about to / will'.
Memory aid: 业 looks like a row of upright posts on a base, like a shop sign or an old tool stand; 'business/trade' is the extended meaning. Origin is unclear, so no firm etymology.
The shape does not explain 与 today (simplified from 與, two hands handing something over). Memory aid: a hand passing a thing along, hence 'give' and then 'and, with'.
广 (house) — the cover on top, as in 店 shop. It marks a room or hall where people celebrate.
大 (big) — the part inside the house. Dictionary story: a great (大) event in a house; 庆祝 celebrate. Memory aid, as 庆 is simplified from 慶.
尸 (body/roof) — the top-left cover, as in 层 and 局. In 展 it works like a cover over cloth that is spread out; memory aid, shape is partly simplified.
衣 (clothing) — a bit of this sits inside 展. Dictionary story: laying out clothes to display them, hence 'unfold, exhibit' in 展示.
曰 (say) — the middle part, a mouth-like box. 更 is a sound-borrowed shape today; the visible parts do not explain 'more / change'. Memory aid: one (一) more thing to say.
⺈ (bent figure) — top part, a person; with 口 and 儿 it forms 免. Origin unclear; Memory aid: a person with a hat slipping out, 'excused'.
儿 (legs) — the bottom part and radical, a walking person, as in 先 first and 兄 older brother.
耳 (ear) — the left part and radical, as in 听 listen. 耶 mostly writes foreign names (耶稣 Jesus), so the ear is only a shape hint.
阝 (city) — the right part, as in 都 and 那. It does not give the sound here. Memory aid: an ear in a foreign city hearing a new name.
鱼 (fish) — the left part and radical, as in 鲜 fresh. In 稣 it is just a visible part; the character is mostly seen in 耶稣 Jesus. Memory aid: a fish.
禾 (grain) — the right part, as in 和 and 秋. The dictionary lists grain as the hint; the 'revive' meaning is not explained by the shape.
尢 (bent leg) — the dictionary radical, a stroke group once meaning a lame person. It does not explain 尤其 'especially' today.
丶 (dot) — the extra stroke on 尢. Memory aid: one dot added to 尢 makes it stand out, hence 'especially'.
攵 (tap) — the right part and radical, a hand with a stick, as in 收. Dictionary story: striking a beast, which takes courage, hence 勇敢 brave.
耳 (ear) — the left part, said to stand for a beast. Memory aid: dare to grab a beast by the ear.
尸 (body) — the top part: a person. Dictionary: a man measuring by pacing; with the stroke below it, the stride or a ruler.
乚 (hook) — the bottom stroke, the measuring step. Memory aid: a foot-length ruler, as in 英尺 foot (unit).
罒 (net) — the top part, as in 罪 crime. Story: stuck in a net, unable to leave, hence 'stop'; in 罢了 it is just the final particle 'that's all'.
去 (go) — the bottom part, as in 法. Dictionary reading: a net blocking you from going; as memory aid.
囗 (enclosure) — the outer box, as in 国 country and 回. The dictionary reading: four walls of a room, with a child (儿) inside; memory aid only, sound-borrowed.
儿 (legs/child) — inside the box, as in 先 and 兄. Memory aid: the shape is simply a box with two legs; it does not explain 'four'.
夭 (young, bending person) — the top part, as in 笑 smile. Dictionary story: a person on stilts, so tall and lofty. In 乔治 George it is just a sound.
黍 (millet) — the left part and radical, a grain plant. 黎 once meant 'black, many'; today it mostly appears in 巴黎 Paris and 黎明 dawn.
弓 (bow) — the main part and radical, as in 张 and 引. Story: two arrows (丨丨) pulled across a bow, hence 'not, negative'; now mainly in foreign names like 弗兰克.
冏 (bright/window) — the lower part; dictionary treats it as the 'bright' hint. Meaning 'trade, business' is better remembered as a market (商店).
口 (mouth) — dictionary radical, as in 吃 eat. Memory aid: a shop-keeper's mouth calling out prices; 商量 is to 'talk it over'.
⺈ (bent figure) — the top part of 尔, a variant stroke group. 尔 is an old form of 'you'; today it appears mainly in foreign names like 比尔 Bill.
小 (small) — the bottom part and radical, as in 少 few. The shape does not explain 'you'; the character is now mostly sound-borrowed.
乛 (hook stroke) — the top-left bent stroke and dictionary radical; a stroke grouping with no meaning of its own.
一 (one) — the bottom bar. 卫 is simplified from 衛 (guard); Memory aid: a bar blocking a corner, a guard at the door.
尸 (body/cover) — the top-left part, as in 局 and 层. Origin in 尉 is unclear; it is only a visible part.
寸 (inch/hand) — the right part and radical, as in 对 and 村. Memory aid: an officer with a hand on the order, as in 上尉 captain.
自 (self/nose) — the middle part, as in 臭 smell; it does not explain 'summer'. Memory aid: your own nose feeling the heat.
夂 (go slowly) — the bottom part and radical, a foot. The old form shows a figure in ceremonial dress; as a memory aid only.
舌 (tongue) — the left part, as in 话 speech. Memory aid: too many wagging tongues create chaos, hence 混乱.
乚 (hook) — the right-hand stroke and dictionary radical. 乱 is simplified from 亂; the stroke does not add meaning.
二 (two) — the top and bottom bars. Dictionary story: five elements between heaven and earth, with a cross in the middle; memory aid, not firmly attested.
尺 (ruler) — the main part, as in 尺寸 size. Dictionary story: a place where measures are discussed (口), like a bureau; 局 also means 'game' as in 结局.
口 (mouth/box) — placed inside 尺. It represents talk or a space; Memory aid: a ruler fitted to a mouth means rules are discussed in an 'office'.
彳 (step) — the left part and radical, as in 往 and 行. It suggests going step by step; in 微 'tiny', as in 微笑 smile. Rest of the shape is unclear.
攵 (tap) — the bottom-right part, as in 收. Memory aid: tapping very lightly with tiny steps, so everything is 'slight'.
二 (two) — the bottom bars. 丑 is an old calendar sign (the second branch) later borrowed for 'ugly'. Memory aid: a clown with two stripes, as in 小丑.
刀 (knife) — the dictionary lists a knife-like stroke group. The shape does not explain 'ugly'; Memory aid only.
十 (ten/cross) — the visible part; 升 once was a ladle measuring grain, then 'to rise'. The shape does not explain this. Memory aid: a ladle lifted high.
而 (and, beard) — the left part and radical; originally a beard. Memory aid: stroking a beard while waiting, a patient person, as in 耐心.
寸 (inch/hand) — the right part, as in 对 and 村; here it means a hand. In 耐 it suggests a hand with patience to measure; Memory aid only.
大 (big/man) — the top part, as in 夫. Dictionary story: a big man wrapped in a long cloth, hence 'cover, set'; used in 外套 coat and 手套 glove.
镸 (long) — the bottom part, a long-hair variant of 長. Memory aid: a long cloth over a big person is a coat or cover.
王 (king/jade) — the middle part, as in 玉. Dictionary story: a jade statue with four holes (口) made in it, seen as a bad omen, so 噩梦 nightmare; memory aid.
口 (mouth) — four of them, dictionary radical. Memory aid: four mouths shouting around a king, a nightmare scene.
山 (mountain) — the top part and radical, as in 岛 island. 岁 is simplified from 歲; Memory aid: a mountain of evenings (夕) passing makes years, 万岁 'long live'.
夕 (evening) — the bottom part, as in 外 and 多. It stands for passing time, so a year is many evenings; memory aid.
亚 (second, Asia) — the top part. Dictionary reading: an advance to the second (亚) day (日), hence 'advance'; 晋级 is to be promoted.
日 (sun) — the bottom part and radical, as in 明 bright. It marks days or time; in 晋 the sun rises to a higher level.
肀 (brush in hand) — the top part and radical, a hand holding a tool. 肃 is simplified from 肅; Memory aid: a hand quietly holding a brush, serious and solemn as in 严肃.
亠 (lid) — the top stroke group, as in 市 and 交. The sound-borrowed number; no meaning link. Memory aid: a lid on top of 八 (eight) ends up as six.
八 (eight) — the bottom part, as in 分 divide. Same shape as 'eight' but the number 六 does not come from it; use it as a visual memory aid.
彐 (hand/snout) — the top part, as in 当 and 归. Dictionary story: a hand (彐) threshing rice, as in 奴隶 slave; the shape is an old tangle of strokes, so memory aid only.
氺 (water-like strokes) — the bottom part, a variant of 水. Memory aid: a servant working near water, a slave to the grain.
幺 (small/thread) — the dictionary radical, as in 么 and 幻. 乡 is simplified from 鄉 (village); the three strokes here look like a thread. Memory aid: a thread looping home to the village.
